meta.title: Túbir — Plant a tree in East Kazakhstan
meta.description: Plant a real tree in East Kazakhstan. We plant for you, you get a video proof. Bring back the green of the region — with us.

hero.badge: Startup · at the start of the road
hero.slogan: Plant a tree that will outlive you
hero.lead: There is a simple idea: a man should plant a tree. Not everyone has the land, time, and team to do it properly. Túbir takes care of that: you choose the species, we plant the tree in East Kazakhstan, record the planting, care for it for the first three years, and issue a certificate with coordinates.

honest.label: Straight up
honest.title: Túbir is a startup. We haven't planted a single tree yet.
honest.text: Right now we have a goal, a team and a plan. What we don't have yet is a planted forest. We're preparing the first batch: scouting land, talking to nurseries, calculating costs and legal details. That's why we don't present someone else's forest as our own. We're honestly asking you to be one of the first to trust us with your tree. Every report will be real — from the day the first spade enters the ground.

future.title: If we don't take this on — nothing will be left for our children.
future.text: A tree lives for hundreds of years. But first, someone has to plant it.

items.title: A man's duty
items.text: Build a house, plant a tree, raise a son. Of the three, the tree is the one you can't do from a ninth-floor flat. We move it from impossible to a single click — no fakes, no virtual reality, the real thing.

items.title: The air we breathe
items.text: Around 83,000 tonnes of harmful emissions a year hang over our region. East Kazakhstan has sat on the country's dirtiest-air list for years. One tree won't stop a factory. But 100,000 trees is a forest. And a forest breathes for us.

items.title: After the polygon
items.text: 456 nuclear blasts in 40 years. 1.7 million people under the fallout. Fields where livestock can't graze. Wells you can't drink from. This land wasn't chosen — it was simply convenient to give away for testing. Now it's time to heal it. A tree is the oldest medicine there is.

flagship.label: Flagship project
flagship.title: Green lungs of our region
flagship.text: For decades East Kazakhstan gave the country metal, uranium, weapons. All that time, it was giving away its own air, its own water, its own forests. Túbir is giving them back. One tree at a time. The goal — 100,000 living trees on our own land. The bigger goal — that the region stops being called just "industrial" and starts being called green again.

legal.offerLead: This document is a public offer. By making a payment on tubir.kz you enter into a contract with us under the terms below.

offerSections.title: 1. Parties
offerSections.text: Túbir LLP (the "Provider"), website tubir.kz, registration in Kazakhstan in progress. The Customer is any individual or legal entity who places a request or makes a payment.

offerSections.title: 2. Subject of the contract
offerSections.text: For the price published on the site, the Provider organises the planting of a tree (or trees) of the chosen species on the project's land in East Kazakhstan, takes care of the tree for 36 months after planting, and provides the Customer with a video report and a personal certificate.

offerSections.title: 3. Price and payment
offerSections.text: The price is shown on each species page and includes the sapling, the planting work, watering and three years of care. Payments are made via Halyk ePay, Kaspi Pay, card or bank transfer to the Provider's account.

offerSections.title: 4. Timing
offerSections.text: Planting takes place in the next suitable season (spring or autumn). The video report and GPS coordinates are sent to the Customer within 30 days of planting.

offerSections.title: 5. Survival guarantee
offerSections.text: If the tree does not survive within the first 12 months, the Provider plants a new tree of the same species at no extra cost and sends a fresh report.

offerSections.title: 6. Refund
offerSections.text: Before physical planting, the Customer may cancel within 7 calendar days and receive a full refund. After planting the service is considered fulfilled and refunds are no longer available.

offerSections.title: 7. Force majeure
offerSections.text: Parties are released from liability for non-performance caused by force majeure (natural disasters, wildfires, epidemics, government action).

offerSections.title: 8. Contact
offerSections.text: All questions — hello@tubir.kz. Address and bank details will be published once the LLP is incorporated.

legal.privacyLead: We care about your data and use it only to handle your request and contact you.

privacySections.title: 1. What we collect
privacySections.text: Name, email, phone, country, dedication text (optional) — what you submit through the form. Plus cookies for site operation and basic analytics (country, language, visit time).

privacySections.title: 2. Why
privacySections.text: To contact you about your request, issue an invoice, agree the planting and send the report.

privacySections.title: 3. Where
privacySections.text: In a secure Supabase database (data centres in EU or US depending on region). Access is limited to the Túbir team.

privacySections.title: 4. To whom
privacySections.text: To no one, except where required by Kazakhstani law. Payment data is processed by the acquiring bank (Halyk Bank); we don't store it.

privacySections.title: 5. Your rights
privacySections.text: You can request a copy, correction or full deletion of your data by writing to hello@tubir.kz. We respond within 30 days.

privacySections.title: 6. Cookies
privacySections.text: We use technical cookies for site operation and analytics cookies for improvements. They can be disabled in your browser settings.

legal.refundLead: Refunds are possible — but the logic differs from a normal purchase, because once the tree is in the ground the service is considered done.

refundSections.title: Before planting — 100% refund
refundSections.text: At any moment before the actual planting, you can cancel. We refund within 7 business days to the same payment method.

refundSections.title: After planting — no refund
refundSections.text: The tree is in the ground, the work is done, the sapling and labour are paid for. No refund applies.

refundSections.title: If the tree doesn't survive
refundSections.text: Within the first 12 months after planting we plant a new tree of the same species, free of charge. No extra payment from you.

refundSections.title: How to request a refund
refundSections.text: Write to hello@tubir.kz with the subject "Refund", include your request number and reason. We reply within 2 business days.

about.title: About
about.missionText: Túbir was born from a simple thought. Millions of men in big cities will never plant a tree — unless someone gives them the land. And millions of hectares of Kazakh land are waiting for those trees. Especially here, in East Kazakhstan, where the factories ran for decades and the nuclear charges went off. We bring those two truths together. You bring the meaning and the means. We bring the land, the hands, the time.
about.teamText: We're a team from East Kazakhstan. Our parents live here. Our children will live here too. We buy the land, bring the saplings, dig, water, film. Faces and stories — coming soon.
about.joinText: Wherever you live — Almaty, Astana, Moscow or London — a tree planted in your name can grow here. On land that remembers both the nuclear tests and decades of factory smoke. A hundred years from now we may be gone, but the tree planted in your honour can still give shade to people not yet born.

polygon.label: Special project
polygon.title: Atonement Forest of the Polygon
polygon.subtitle: Trees on the land that took the heaviest hit — and is still silent about it.
polygon.lead: In 40 years the Semipalatinsk Polygon absorbed 456 nuclear blasts. Radioactive fallout covered 304,000 square kilometres. 1.7 million people lived underneath it. And land where nothing was supposed to grow again.
polygon.conceptText: A separate flagship project of Túbir on lands adjacent to the former test site. Every tree here carries the dedication "to those who couldn't grow up here." This isn't marketing — it's an attempt to bring life back to where it was taken.

blocks.title: Partnership with NNC RK
blocks.text: We are in dialogue with the National Nuclear Center of Kazakhstan to agree planting sites and protocols in the safe zones.

blocks.title: Coordination with Abai region

blocks.title: Dedications, not names
blocks.text: There's no "Ivan Petrov" certificate here. Here it's "in memory of grandfather, who didn't live to 60." A different tone.

blocks.title: Free for the affected
blocks.text: Families officially recognised as affected by the nuclear tests can plant a tree free of charge — that's the first thing we're working towards.

list.title: Triple duty
list.subtitle: House · tree · son — literally in one box
list.description: A gift box for the man who jokes he ought to plant a tree but never gets around to it. Inside: a symbolic handmade brick (a piece of an old house), a planting certificate with GPS coordinates in East Kazakhstan, a voucher for a children's book about Kazakh nature for future or already-born kids. House — one stone. Tree — real. Son — a place for the book.

list.subtitle: When your son turns eighteen
list.description: A tree planted in honour of the eighteenth birthday. With GPS coordinates and a tree passport — a small paper booklet with photo, coordinates, date and place of planting. You'll come back to this place in 5, 10, 30 years. The tree will be there, growing alongside him.

list.title: In memory
list.subtitle: A tree instead of a wreath
list.description: When someone close passes — on the land where they lived, you can leave not a stone but a tree. You can come back ten years later. The certificate — quiet, dark-toned. Coordinates — forever.

list.title: Gift a tree
list.subtitle: When you want to give an act, not another object
list.description: He has a car, a watch, a gym membership, a streaming subscription. What he doesn't have is a tree planted in his honour. An e-card by email + a certificate in his name + a video report when we plant it. Works for International Women's Day, birthdays, weddings.

paragraphs.title: Where we start
paragraphs.body: Túbir is a startup. We have not yet planted a single tree. There is no registered company, no plot, no video of a shovel entering the ground. There is an idea, a team, and a plan for the year ahead.

paragraphs.title: Why we write now
paragraphs.body: Most sites like ours don't write letters like this. They pick the version of events where everything already works. We choose the other one — to say things as they are and ask for trust now, before we have proved anything.

paragraphs.title: Why East Kazakhstan
paragraphs.body: Because we're from here. When we say «this land remembers the factories and the test site» — we remember with it. This is not a marketing formula. It's the address where our parents live.

paragraphs.title: What we promise
paragraphs.body: Real trees. A video of every planting. GPS coordinates. Three years of care after planting. If a tree doesn't take, we plant a new one at our own cost.

paragraphs.title: What we don't promise
paragraphs.body: That everything will go smoothly. That the first season will work out the first try. That we'll find the perfect plot in a month. That our certificates will look better than those of teams who've been at this for three years.

paragraphs.title: What we ask
paragraphs.body: We don't need a hundred thousand people today. We need the first hundred. People who'll say «I want to be first» before we've planted a single tree. These hundred are the Founders. Their trees go into the very first batch, their names go on the stele at the plot.

quotes: One man, one root. Túbir is an attempt to move a physical duty from the unreachable into a single click — without deceit and without the virtual.

map.title: Where the trees will grow
map.subtitle: The exact spot will appear here after the plot is acquired. For now — a concept.
map.lead: The Túbir map has two layers. Today it's a plan: a plot in East Kazakhstan, close to Öskemen, within reach of the Semipalatinsk test site and the Semey ribbon forest. Tomorrow it becomes an interactive map where every tree has coordinates, an owner's name, and a video report.
map.placeholderNote: Schematic for illustration. The real plot will appear here after acquisition.

plans.title: Exact coordinates
plans.text: Every tree will get a GPS pin on a public map. Open to anyone who wants to verify the forest isn't imagined.

plans.title: Search by surname
plans.text: In the «Family Forest» concept the map shows every tree planted by — or in honour of — people with a shared surname. A living family tree.

plans.title: Project zones
plans.text: Layers on the map: main plot, Polygon Forest site, corporate plantings, orchards. Each with its own legend.

plans.title: Open API
plans.text: The map will be embeddable and open to researchers. Partner ESG reports can link to specific points.

map.ctaText: The first 100 Founders get a place on the map before we plant the first tree.

onePager.title: Túbir — real trees in East Kazakhstan
onePager.lead: An online service for planting real trees in East Kazakhstan, with video reports, GPS coordinates, and three years of post-planting care. Under the Taza Qazaqstan concept.

pillars.title: Real, not virtual
pillars.text: Every tree on the ground, on video, with a GPS pin. Not carbon credits, not pixels — a living trunk.

pillars.title: East Kazakhstan context
pillars.text: A region of industrial emissions and the Semipalatinsk test site. We return the debt to the land that raised us.

pillars.title: Transparency
pillars.text: Open statistics, reports, coordinates, cost breakdown per tree. Documentation for CSR and ESG partners.

onePager.conceptText: Core product — tree planting on demand for individuals and companies. On top — two special projects: the Polygon Atonement Forest (partnership with the National Nuclear Centre and the Abay Region) and the Family Forest (an open map of family plantings). And a B2B stream for East Kazakhstan enterprises.
onePager.askText: From the akimat — help allocating or leasing a plot in East Kazakhstan (15–30 ha over five years) and coordination with the forestry service. From Halyk Orman and the Ministry of Ecology — sapling supply. From funds — support for the starter batch. We're ready to sign under the Taza Qazaqstan concept.
